about.statement: I connect new platforms to hard legacy enterprise systems.
about.summary: Full-stack engineer with {{years}} years of shipping production software in TypeScript/React, Node.js, .NET and SQL. At IC Solutions I work on ICPen, a document signing platform with around {{deployments}} deployments in hospitals, banks and energy companies. I build its features from the ground up: database schema, .NET microservices and gRPC APIs, the React frontend of the main application and its admin apps, and deployment configuration, including the sign-in stack of Kerberos SSO, LDAP and Active Directory. I own the work end to end, from architecture and implementation details to production fixes.

facts.deployments: deployments in hospitals, banks and energy

icpen.title: ICPen Identity
icpen.tagline: Windows SSO and LDAP sign-in for a document signing platform.
points: Kerberos single sign-on through nginx SPNEGO and a custom IdentityServer4 grant validator, so staff sign in with their existing Windows domain accounts.
Multi-domain LDAP and Active Directory integration with a plugin architecture: a dynamic admin panel built from Module Federation 2.0 remotes, driven by a gRPC configuration service.
Replaced server-rendered Razor login pages with a React/TypeScript login UI.
Diagnosed and fixed nginx caching bugs affecting deployments inside customer networks.

kiribati.title: Kiribati AI
kiribati.tagline: An internal AI assistant platform, used daily.
points: Built and maintain an AI assistant platform for a Polish travel company on top of the open-source chatbot-ui codebase, used daily by 10 to 30 staff.
OpenAI models with model selection per user and per project.
Shared and private workspaces with custom assistants that staff configure and scope to each workspace.
PostgreSQL data model for workspaces, projects, members, per-user model settings and assistants, plus i18n and a custom design system matching the brand.

transpiler.title: Transpiler
transpiler.tagline: C# logic running in the browser.
points: Custom engine that transpiles C# to JavaScript, so logic written once in C# runs in web browsers. It powered online banking forms.
A converter for BPMN process models.
Found and optimised slow-running queries in Microsoft SQL Server.
Designed APIs with backend developers and built the React/TypeScript clients consuming them.

thesis.title: Attention
points: MSc thesis in Artificial Intelligence: applying the Transformer architecture to recommender systems.
Selected for the US-Poland Science and Technology Symposium in Palo Alto, focused on applying AI to real-world problems.
Co-founded and hosted a university AI conference with keynote speakers from Stanford and Berkeley.

Build ICPen features end to end: database schema, .NET microservices and gRPC APIs on Kubernetes, the React/TypeScript frontend of the main application and admin apps (built as microfrontends) and configuration, in a team of 5 developers, 1 DevOps engineer and 3 testers.
Sign-in stack: Kerberos SSO, multi-domain LDAP and Active Directory with a Module Federation plugin architecture, and a React login UI.
Frontend platform: migration from npm to pnpm, a shared DataTable on Material React Table v3, Module Federation fixes for Shadow DOM and Tailwind CSS v4.
Set the architecture and implementation details of the features I build; mentoring and onboarding, code review, unit and integration tests.
Internal AI assistant platform for a travel company, owning the full cycle from schema to UI to release.
Requirements and bug reports straight from the client, turned into prioritised fixes and features.
Part of a US-based team, collaborating across time zones in English.
Backend services and React/TypeScript interfaces for a microservice system running in Docker.
Owned milestones from first design to final delivery, agreeing technical proposals with stakeholders.
C# to JavaScript transpiler powering online banking forms, and a BPMN model converter.
SQL Server query optimisation, API design and React/TypeScript clients.
Worked directly with customers and mentored newer developers.
Designed and maintained databases, built APIs and the data clients consuming them.
Supported development, QA and UX staff on new products and resolved issues during deployments.
